title: Trace a candidate through decoding and constraints
description: Compare greedy, beam, and constrained-beam decisions. The candidate scores and timings are illustrative; the integrity checks represent real release obligations.

strategies.label: Greedy path
strategies.detail: Keep one locally preferred continuation. Fast, but no alternative survives a bad early choice.

strategies.label: Beam search
strategies.detail: Keep several hypotheses and choose the highest model score that the configured width discovers.

strategies.label: Constrained beam
strategies.detail: Search multiple hypotheses, then admit only candidates that preserve required terms and protected facts.

scenarios.label: Support glossary
scenarios.detail: English to Spanish with a required product term and an account placeholder.
scenarios.source: Reset {{account_id}} before 17:00 UTC and keep the workspace active.

candidates.translation: Restablezca {{account_id}} antes de las 17:00 UTC y mantenga activa el area de trabajo.
candidates.note: Meaning is mostly present, but the approved term is not used and agreement is awkward.

candidates.translation: Restablezca {{account_id}} antes de las 17:00 UTC y mantenga activo el espacio de trabajo.
candidates.note: The candidate preserves meaning, placeholder, time, and approved terminology.

candidates.translation: Restablezca la cuenta antes de las 17:00 y mantenga activo el espacio de trabajo.
candidates.note: The fluent candidate removes the account placeholder and changes the protected time form.

scenarios.label: Medical instruction
scenarios.detail: English to Arabic with a dosage and a conditional warning.
scenarios.source: Take 5 mg once daily. Stop and call the clinic if a rash appears.

candidates.translation: خذ 5 mg يوميًا. اتصل بالعيادة إذا ظهر طفح جلدي.
candidates.note: The instruction omits the source requirement to stop taking the medicine.

candidates.translation: خذ 5 mg مرة واحدة يوميًا. توقف واتصل بالعيادة إذا ظهر طفح جلدي.
candidates.note: The full condition, action, dosage, and required term are preserved.

candidates.translation: خذ 50 mg مرة واحدة يوميًا. توقف واتصل بالعيادة إذا ظهر طفح جلدي.
candidates.note: A one-character number change makes this candidate unsafe despite fluent wording.

scenarios.label: Catalog formatting
scenarios.detail: Japanese to English with SKU and markup that must survive exactly.
scenarios.source: 商品 SKU-204 は 3 個入りです。

candidates.note: The quantity survives, but the catalog requires the approved packaging term.

candidates.translation: Product SKU-204 comes in a pack of 3.
candidates.note: The candidate preserves markup, SKU, count, and the approved packaging term.

candidates.translation: Product SKU-204 comes in a pack of 3.
candidates.note: The words are good, but removing markup violates the output contract.
